notes: Amaris Consulting L2, additive-only bans on top of L1. Basis (judgement from a sample of about a dozen amaris.com pages, 2026-10-06): the brand's own copy describes itself as craftspeople, dependable partners and teammates, and frames the firm as a guide rather than a vendor imposing solutions; hype and vendor-distance vocabulary does not appear in the pages read. Bans are therefore off-voice rather than proven-avoided. Register rules (no exclamation marks; plain first-person plural; French uses nous and vous) live in voice-profile.md as prose.
